description: Source code for a dynamic string library (sds.c) implementing string manipulation functions, memory management, and string utilities for SDS (Simple Dynamic Strings).

methods.name: hi_sdsnew
methods.description: Create a new SDS string from a null-terminated C string.

methods.name: hi_sdsnewlen
methods.description: Create a new SDS string with specified content and length.

methods.name: hi_sdsempty
methods.description: Create an empty SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdsfree
methods.description: Free an SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdsdup
methods.description: Duplicate an SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdslen
methods.description: Get the length of an SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdscmp
methods.description: Compare two SDS strings.

methods.name: hi_sdscat
methods.description: Concatenate a null-terminated C string to SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdscatsds
methods.description: Concatenate another SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdscpy
methods.description: Copy a null-terminated C string into SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdscpylen
methods.description: Copy a string with specified length into SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdscatprintf
methods.description: Append formatted string using printf-like format.

methods.name: hi_sdscatfmt
methods.description: Append formatted string with limited format specifiers.

methods.name: hi_sdstrim
methods.description: Trim characters from both ends of SDS string.

methods.name: hi_sdsrange
methods.description: Extract a substring based on start and end indices.

methods.name: hi_sdstolower
methods.description: Convert SDS string to lowercase.

methods.name: hi_sdstoupper
methods.description: Convert SDS string to uppercase.

methods.name: hi_sdsAllocSize
methods.description: Get total allocated size of SDS string including header and null terminator.

methods.name: hi_sdsAllocPtr
methods.description: Get pointer to the actual SDS allocation.

methods.name: hi_sdsMakeRoomFor
methods.description: Ensure SDS string has enough free space for additional data.

methods.name: hi_sdsRemoveFreeSpace
methods.description: Reallocate SDS string to remove free space at the end.

methods.name: hi_sdsgrowzero
methods.description: Grow SDS string to a specified length, initializing new bytes to zero.

methods.name: hi_sdscatlen
methods.description: Append binary-safe data of specified length.

methods.name: hi_sdscat
methods.description: Append null-terminated C string.

methods.name: hi_sdscatrepr
methods.description: Append an escaped representation of data.

methods.name: hi_sdssplitlen
methods.description: Split string into tokens based on separator with length.

methods.name: hi_sdsfreesplitres
methods.description: Free array of split SDS strings.

methods.name: hi_sdssplitargs
methods.description: Split a line into arguments considering quotes and escapes.

methods.name: hi_sdsmapchars
methods.description: Replace characters in SDS string based on from-to mapping.

methods.name: hi_sdsjoin
methods.description: Join array of C strings with separator.

methods.name: hi_sdsjoinsds
methods.description: Join array of SDS strings with separator.

methods.name: hi_sdsll2str
methods.description: Convert long long to string.

methods.name: hi_sdsull2str
methods.description: Convert unsigned long long to string.

methods.name: hi_sdsfromlonglong
methods.description: Create SDS string from long long value.
